name: Salvage Loader
desc: A cargo mech whose safeties have failed, and which has decided that you're freight.

intro: A cargo loader lurches out of the hold with a warning beacon turning on its shoulder, and its recorded voice asks you to stand clear.
A loader twice your height clamps onto a bulkhead, tears it free, and turns its lamps on you.
hit: A claw scoops you up and stacks you against the wall, and a recorded voice thanks you for your patience.
A cargo arm swings around on its full radius and hits you like a falling crate.
It drops a pallet on you, then pauses to check that the pallet is undamaged.
miss: The claws close on the space you just left, and crush a fuel drum into a neat cube.
It tries to stack you, misjudges the height, and puts an arm through the ceiling above your head.
You dive under the arm, and the loader's warning tone follows you across the deck.
crit: It gets both claws around you and lifts. "Load secure," says the recorded voice, as the pressure builds.
defeated: The loader sags on its hydraulics, and the recorded voice tells you that this shift is over.
Its lamps fade, and the recorded voice asks you to report any damage to your supervisor.
joins: {Enemy} reverses into the fight with its warning tone going, and you barely get out of its way.
stunned: {Enemy} halts mid-lift with its lamps flickering, and politely asks you to wait for a supervisor.
